contact.head: Contact
contact.text: Are you looking for a motivated developer to strengthen your team? I am always open to exciting job offers, projects, or career opportunities as a Frontend or Full-Stack Developer. With structured thinking, clean code, and a lot of passion, I bring real value to your projects. Feel free to get in touch – I look forward to connecting with you!
myPorjects.orgaHead: How I have organised my work process
myProjects.aboutText:
A simple Jump-and-Run game based on an object-oriented approach. Help pepe to find
                  coins and salsa bottles to fight against the enboss chicken.
myProjects.groupExpText: This project was the perfect chance to dive deep into Angular v22. Working with standalone components and Signals showed me how exciting it is to master cutting-edge web technologies.
myProjects.learnedHead: How I have organized my work
myProjects.learnedText: I ensure clean code through modular components, clear naming (files, variables, classes), thorough documentation, and structured testing.
myProjects.name: My Projects
myProjects.orgaText: I focus on building modular projects and reusable components. Through precise naming of variables, classes, and files, combined with clear documentation and structured testing, the code remains highly scalable and easy to maintain.
mySkills.text: I am motivated to continually improve my skills, implement innovative solutions and stay abreast of new technologies.

refs.header: Need a teamplayer? Here’s what my colleagues say about me
whyMe.text: For me, coding is more than just lines of text – it is the perfect blend of analytical thinking and creative freedom. I thrive on tackling complex challenges with a strong problem-solving mindset. Driven by persistence through every debugging session and a deep love for collaboration, I am excited to build impactful solutions together.
